title: Plans and pricing | Verse Engine by Ctruh
description: Plans and pricing in the Verse Engine by Ctruh docs: what it is, how to use it, and where it fits in your 3D workflow.

docs.article:
Plans and pricing#

Start free. Every new account gets a 14-day trial with Pro features, then moves to Free unless you subscribe. The pricing page always shows the live numbers; this page explains them. Prices below are in US dollars; visitors in India see rupees only (the price is decided by our server from your country, never by a switch on the page).

Taxes. Rupee prices exclude GST: 18% GST is added at checkout (for example ₹7,999 / month + 18% GST), and businesses can claim it with their GSTIN. Dollar prices: taxes are calculated at checkout.

  • Extra seats on Starter, Pro and Scale: $15 (₹999 + 18% GST) a month each, $150 (₹9,990 + 18% GST) a year.
  • Annual billing is ten months' price for twelve.
  • Your viewers never need a plan or an account. A published scene keeps opening whatever plan its owner is on.

When you reach an allowance#

We tell you at 80% and again at 100% (in the app, on your billing page, by email at most twice a week, and on WhatsApp). At 100% that action stops until you upgrade or your billing month resets; nothing is deleted. Allowances reset on your billing date (on the 1st for Free and the trial).

Bandwidth is the one exception that never breaks a link: if your scenes use all of the month's bandwidth, viewers keep opening them in a lighter version and you see a notice to upgrade.

Pay as you go (coming soon)#

On paid plans you will be able to go past an allowance and pay only for the extra. Until it switches on, reaching an allowance asks you to upgrade and nothing extra is charged.

The trial#

Every new account (one per person and organisation) gets 14 days with Pro features and these allowances: 5 GB storage, 10 GB bandwidth, 25,000 API calls, 3 Verse Homes, 3 films, 1 room capture, 50 renders, 1 seat and uploads up to 2 GB. The badge stays on and custom branding is not included.

Upgrade during the trial and the offer is applied at checkout automatically: **25% off your first 3 months on a monthly plan, or 20% off your first year** on an annual plan. The offer ends with the trial.

After 14 days the account moves to Free. Nothing is deleted and your scenes keep opening; creating more needs a plan.

Broker packs#

One-time, prepaid packs made for WhatsApp: 10 Verse Homes + 10 films for $12 (₹999 + 18% GST), or **50 + 50 for $59 (₹4,999 + 18% GST)**. They are used after your plan's monthly allowance and never expire.

Discount codes#

Enter a code on the pricing page, or open a link with the code in it (for example verse.ctruh.com/pricing?code=YOURCODE); the code is kept while you sign up. One code per purchase: a code is not combined with the trial offer (the bigger saving applies) unless the code says it can be.

Plans from before October 2026#

If you subscribed to Pro ($79), Studio, Verse for Real Estate or All Access, nothing you pay changes. Your subscription keeps its plan and price, and gets the new allowances wherever those are higher than what you had. These plans are no longer sold to new customers.

Which currency you pay in#

Checkout is run by our payment partner, Dodo Payments, who adds the right sales tax, VAT or GST for your country and issues the invoice. Customers in India pay in rupees (cards, UPI, net banking); everyone else in US dollars.

Changing plan#

  • Upgrade from the pricing page or the upgrade sheet; the new plan applies at once.
  • Cancel or downgrade in Billing; you keep the plan until the period you paid for ends, and your scenes stay. A payment that fails has a 7-day grace period before the plan drops.
  • Refunds: within 7 days of your first payment (or of an annual renewal). See the refund policy, the terms and the privacy policy.
  • Enterprise: request a callback on the pricing page; a specialist calls you back.
  • Not sure which plan? Write to hello@ctruh.com.
